dedupe_keys.name: cnbh 10 m chinese building height at 10 m resolution 2020

description: CNBH-10 m estimates building height for all of China in 2020 at 10 m resolution, the first national building height map at that resolution according to its authors. A random forest model on a cloud platform combines radar, optical and night light images, and the combinational shadow index is the most important predictor at 15.1 percent. Against observed heights the authors report a root mean square error of 6.1 m, a mean absolute error of 5.2 m and a correlation of 0.77 at national scale. The Zenodo release, updated in April 2023, holds 318 GeoTIFF tiles and an overview image; a preprint is in a separate record and the paper is in Remote Sensing of Environment. Coverage: all of China. Access: free from Zenodo. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: modelled heights with errors of several metres, so tall buildings and dense cores are least certain; one year only. Simulation uses are building volume and floor area inputs for exposure and population models, and urban morphology for heat and wind studies. Related records: the CBRA rooftop area maps and 3D-GloBFP.
